origin.description: Two files with the same bytes.
origin.details: Two files with the same bytes.
origin.example:
a <- tempfile(); b <- tempfile()
writeBin(as.raw(c(1, 2, 3)), a)
writeBin(as.raw(c(1, 2, 3)), b)
compare_file_binary(a, b)

translation.description: Two files with the same bytes.
translation.details: Two files with the same bytes. code is a callable. local_* is a context manager.
translation.example:
from testthat import *

a = tempfile.mktemp(); b = tempfile.mktemp()
open(a, "wb").write(bytes([1, 2, 3]))
open(b, "wb").write(bytes([1, 2, 3]))
return compare_file_binary(a, b)
